sections.description: Use a [[honeycomb]] on any of these 15 waxable [[Copper#Oxidizing blocks|copper block variants]]: [[Block of Copper|Block of Copper]], [[Chiseled Copper|Chiseled Copper]], [[Copper Bars|Copper Bars]], [[Copper Bulb|Copper Bulb]], [[Copper Chain|Copper Chain]], [[Copper Chest|Copper Chest]], [[Copper Door|Copper Door]], [[Copper Golem Statue|Copper Golem Statue]], [[Copper Grate|Copper Grate]], [[Copper Lantern|Copper Lantern]], [[Copper Trapdoor|Copper Trapdoor]], [[Cut Copper|Cut Copper]], [[Cut Copper Slab|Cut Copper Slab]], [[Cut Copper Stairs|Cut Copper Stairs]], [[Lightning Rod|Lightning Rod]]. The block can be in any of its four [[oxidation]] stages, but cannot already be waxed.
sections.gameDescription: Apply Honeycomb to a Copper block!
sections.title: Wax On

sections.description: Have all of these 34 status [[effect]]s applied to the player at the same time: [[Absorption|Absorption]], [[Bad Omen|Bad Omen]], [[Blindness|Blindness]], [[Breath of the Nautilus|Breath of the Nautilus]], [[Conduit Power|Conduit Power]], [[Darkness|Darkness]], [[Dolphin's Grace|Dolphin's Grace]], [[Fire Resistance|Fire Resistance]], [[Glowing|Glowing]], [[Haste|Haste]], [[Hero of the Village|Hero of the Village]], [[Hunger (effect)|Hunger]], [[Infested|Infested]], [[Invisibility|Invisibility]], [[Jump Boost|Jump Boost]], [[Levitation|Levitation]], [[Mining Fatigue|Mining Fatigue]], [[Nausea|Nausea]], [[Night Vision|Night Vision]], [[Oozing|Oozing]], [[Poison|Poison]], [[Raid Omen|Raid Omen]], [[Regeneration|Regeneration]], [[Resistance|Resistance]], [[Slow Falling|Slow Falling]], [[Slowness|Slowness]], [[Speed|Speed]], [[Strength|Strength]], [[Trial Omen|Trial Omen]], [[Water Breathing|Water Breathing]], [[Weakness|Weakness]], [[Weaving|Weaving]], [[Wind Charged|Wind Charged]], [[Wither (effect)|Wither]]. The source of the effects is irrelevant for the purposes of this advancement. Other status effects may be applied to the player, but are ignored for this advancement. See also: [[:Tutorial:Advancement guide/How Did We Get Here?|Tutorial:Advancement guide/How Did We Get Here?]]. This is a hidden advancement, meaning that it can be viewed by the player only after completing it, regardless of if its child advancement(s), if any, have been completed.
sections.gameDescription: Have every effect applied at the same time
sections.reward: 1000XP [[experience]]
sections.title: How Did We Get Here?
